correctness.rationale: For each feasible integer t, conditional uniform matching exchangeability gives internal/internal or internal/bridge crossing probability 1/3 and bridge/bridge crossing probability 1/2. Summing these over p=(a-t)/2, q=(b-t)/2 and t bridge chords gives an exact formula whose t^2 coefficient vanishes. Algebra yields slope (2n-3)/12. Full finite matching enumeration for n=3..7 confirms 291 exact assertions, with all-size correctness furnished by the independent combinatorial proof.

value.rationale: The marked chord degree is a local degree, and remaining crossing pairs are a natural global edge statistic. Arc imbalance materially changes the marked-degree distribution, yet the full conditional expected remaining-edge count has a universal slope across all spans. The structural cancellation for all feasible degree levels is not a routine consequence of marginal means or covariance, and gives exact finite-size local-to-global prediction.
